name: Hyperlink
remarks: The Hyperlink object is a member of the Hyperlinks collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the range that the specified hyperlink is attached to.

properties.name: Shape
properties.description: Returns a Shape object that represents the shape attached to the specified hyperlink.

properties.name: SubAddress
properties.description: Returns or sets the location within the document associated with the hyperlink. Read/write String.

properties.name: Address
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the address of the target document.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns a Long value, containing an MsoHyperlinkType constant, that represents the location of the HTML frame.

properties.name: EmailSubject
properties.description: Returns or sets the text string of the specified hyperlink's email subject line. The subject line is appended to the hyperlink's address. Read/write String.

properties.name: ScreenTip
properties.description: Returns or sets the ScreenTip text for the specified hyperlink. Read/write String.

properties.name: TextToDisplay
properties.description: Returns or sets the text to be displayed for the specified hyperlink. The default value is the address of the hyperlink. Read/write String.

methods.name: AddToFavorites
methods.description: Adds a shortcut to the workbook or hyperlink to the Favorites folder.

methods.name: Follow
methods.signature: Follow([NewWindow As Variant], [AddHistory As Variant], [ExtraInfo As Variant], [Method As Variant], [HeaderInfo As Variant])
methods.description: Displays a cached document, if it's already been downloaded. Otherwise, this method resolves the hyperlink, downloads the target document, and displays the document in the appropriate application.

parameters.name: NewWindow
parameters.description: True to display the target application in a new window. The default value is False.

parameters.name: AddHistory
parameters.description: Not used. Reserved for future use.

parameters.name: ExtraInfo
parameters.description: A String or byte array that specifies additional information for HTTP to use to resolve the hyperlink. For example, you can use _ExtraInfo_ to specify the coordinates of an image map, the contents of a form, or a FAT file name.

parameters.name: Method
parameters.description: Specifies the way _ExtraInfo_ is attached. Can be one of the MsoExtraInfoMethod constants.

parameters.name: HeaderInfo
parameters.description: A String that specifies header information for the HTTP request. The default value is an empty string.

methods.name: CreateNewDocument
methods.signature: CreateNewDocument(Filename As String, EditNow As Boolean, Overwrite As Boolean)
methods.description: Creates a new document linked to the specified hyperlink.

parameters.name: Filename
parameters.description: The file name of the specified document.

parameters.name: EditNow
parameters.description: True to have the specified document open immediately in its associated editing environment. The default value is True.

parameters.name: Overwrite
parameters.description: True to overwrite any existing file of the same name in the same folder. False if any existing file of the same name is preserved and the _FileName_ argument specifies a new file name. The default value is False.
